title: nft_buy_offers
key_points: The nft_buy_offers method returns the list of buy offers for NFTs.
It takes no arguments and returns a JSON object with two fields:
- sells: array - an array containing information about active buy orders.
- meta: object - metadata about the returned data.
limitations: The documentation does not specify the exact format or fields of the 'sells' array or 'meta' object.
Real-time accuracy is unknown without testing.
asserts: The nft_buy_offers method exists to retrieve buy offers for NFTs from XRP Ledger's public API.
